name: 12to11
description:
12to11 is a lightweight Wayland-to-X11 bridge that enables running Wayland applications on an X server. It acts as an in-process Wayland compositor translating Wayland client requests into standard X11 window operations, allowing modern Wayland-exclusive software to integrate seamlessly with traditional X11 window managers and desktop environments.

Features:
- Seamless execution of Wayland applications as regular top-level X11 windows
- Broad Wayland protocol support including wl_compositor, wl_shm, and xdg_wm_base
- Hardware-accelerated rendering through EGL and OpenGL ES 2.0
- Pointer constraints, relative pointer motions, and multi-touch gestures
- Compatible with lightweight window managers such as dwm, i3, and Openbox
